subject: general
question:
Four figures have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24f8943c9fc37774e701d95a37c8f3280e61473275f2916d9ca506af2114ba97.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d57c4d478bff0e3827953d03e2413994e0ca6a3e32826379a8811d27a81bd72.png]
solution:
Explanation:

A quartet is a group of 4 similar things, in this case a quartet looks like this: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd648b3b27c4feff7dcc018b353574b8bee58200c25d006282cc0dfee11f3eee.png] 

We consider the given figures: 

Figure 1) There is at least one quartet present in the pattern.

Figure 2) There is at least one quartet present in the pattern.

Figure 3) There is no quartet present in the pattern.

Figure 4) There is at least one quartet present in the pattern.

So, **Figure 3 is odd one.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**
